[Ritsuka’s Strategy to Form Alliance With Both Ishtar and Quetzalcoatl]

The team reviewed the information they have about the goddess Gorgon coming to the conclusion that they can’t defeat her by themselves leaving them with the only choice to form alliance with one of the other goddesses because the natural enemy of goddesses are other goddesses.

With this Gilgamesh told Ritsuka that they need to negotiate with Lady Ishtar since she is most likely to be the only one that would help them between the three goddesses.

But before that a sudden attack on Uruk had been reported which was done by the hand of the goddess Quetzalcoatl who told them that she will start killing one hundred people every day until she kills everyone and goes back to her jungle.

Now this creates a new problem which is to get rid of her or at the very least stop her at all cost to prevent her from destroying Uruk.

But Gilgamesh and Merlin said they need to prioritise the negotiation with Lady Ishtar meaning they now have two things to do.

Ritsuka decided to separate the team into two : 

First team to get rid of Quetzalcoatl [Ritsuka + Merlin + Mash + Ana + Jaguarman + Kiyohime]

Second team to negotiate with Ishtar [Arjuna (Alone)]

[First team situation]

Yesterday they prepared to fight Quetzalcoatl to distract her while Ritsuka destroys the symbol above her temple which gives her power to fight.

But Ritsuka revealed that information to Quetzalcoatl exposing their plan so that they can negotiate with her which she answered a few of their questions before fighting them.

Ultimately speaking Quetzalcoatl crushed all of them but Ritsuka, and while all of that was happening Ritsuka finally reached to the top on of her temple next to her symbol meaning all he has to do is to destroy it but he decided not to and started questioning her once again trying to understand her.

Saying that is his joy. Asking her what is her joy? Is it fighting or defeating others? Or what?

Which she answered “It is to understand one another”

By this information Ritsuka decided to come up with the crazy solution to her joy by ordering Jaguarman to send him very high in the sky replicating Quetzalcoatl style in fighting knowing very well he might die from the fall and Quetzalcoatl saved him.

And then asked him why would he do that? Telling him she might have left him to die.

Which he answered saying “That didn’t cross my mind at all, because you Quetzalcoatl ….. Love humans, don’t you?”

Making her immediately surrender and she joined their team.
